canonicalContractDecision.modelCoreOwner: Model API owns parsedCv, jobFitAlignment evidence, atsFriendliness evidence, overallImpression evidence, candidate reranking scores, model name/version, createdAt

currentModelApiContract.auth: Bearer service token unless local/test unauthenticated bypass allowed

multipartBehavior.cvFile: requires exactly one cvFile; content-type application/pdf or application/octet-stream; PDF magic bytes required
multipartBehavior.jobCandidates: form field parsed as JSON array
multipartBehavior.jobRoles: reads repeated jobRoles form values and also accepts a JSON array string
multipartBehavior.rankingPolicy: form field parsed as JSON object/null

parsedPayload.backendMetadata: allows safe trace/hydration hints including title, companyName, locationDisplay, and sourceUpdatedAt
parsedPayload.candidateRequirements: accepts strings or Backend requirement objects and derives scoring text from value
parsedPayload.numericFeatures: accepts approved numericSignals or numericFeatures, but not both
parsedPayload.profile: built from parsed PDF text, targetRoles, normalized skills, detected section names

responseBehavior.atsFriendliness: returns score, detectedIssues, parseQuality, and evidence list
responseBehavior.candidateReranking: returns model-core candidate IDs, bounded scores, match level, skill evidence, and no hydrated fields
responseBehavior.model: returns only { name, version } on internal response
responseBehavior.observability: kept out of internal response body; health/model-info expose operational readiness separately
responseBehavior.overallImpression: returns score and evidence list; Backend owns prose
responseBehavior.parsedCv: returns { status, pageCount, textLength, detectedSections, extractionEvidence }
responseBehavior.timestamp: uses createdAt in internal model-core payload

validation.forbiddenFields: backend/public owner keys rejected anywhere in model-core payload
validation.recommendations: max requested; jobId must belong to request candidate set and be unique
